source: AGENTS.md content requirements and user correction on 2026-07-08
text: Social publishing work must pass a social-media-manager polish gate before scheduling; raw internal labels such as CTA: must not reach public posts.

Multi-agent work uses system/*.md policy docs: paid/current best model for complex/final review; free/free-tier/local workers for low-risk parallel work; every accepted worker output needs job-ledger attribution and validation.
Fan-out repo work uses one isolated branch/worktree per worker, parent/child job-ledger rows, worker briefs under .agents/fanout, and reconciliation before merge or project-memory update.

Cross-project priority uses .agents/priority-queue.jsonl plus project_agent_priority.py weekly review; scoring balances user priority, business value, urgency, blockers, effort, risk, cost, expected impact, unblock value, fan-out suitability, human help, free/local model fit, and paid/human review requirements.

Meaningful repo work must use SDLC start gates: check human changes, pull development if present else main, use feature/fix/agent branch or worktree, use existing CI first, prefer IaC for infra/service/cron/tunnel/deploy changes, and record accepted human work in the job ledger.

Markdown vault support lives at ~/vault as a readable synthesis layer only: raw captures go to inbox/raw and are never edited, processed notes/daily/weekly/monthly graph health are committed, MCP filesystem access is scoped to /home/ubuntu/vault only, and .agents JSONL/project memory/job ledger remain authoritative.

Fitsek photorealistic assets are synthetic/faceless only: prompts/provenance under docs/assets/photoreal-faceless-* and docs/brand-image-provenance.md; do not frame them as customer proof, testimonials, before/after results, medical evidence, or guaranteed outcomes.
